environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'warehouse' with a Kubernetes Service of type ClusterIP exposed via an NLB ingress. The gRPC port 50051 is directly accessible from any pod in the cluster and from the NLB target group. No network policies are applied. The StreamBatchUpdate endpoint is accessible to any gRPC client that can reach the pod IP or service DNS name. Pod runs with default securityContext.
